name: CITIC Guoan Information Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: CITIC Guoan Information Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the enterprise digital intelligence, real estate, and other businesses in China. The company offers operations, sales, and services for various sectors, including finance, telecommunications, internet, and public utilities; television program services, as well as video-on-demand, high-definition movies and TV shows, cable broadband, and 5G broadcasting services; and construction, transmission, advertising, and smart broadcasting for government and corporate clients.
